q25.source: Qwen/Qwen2.5-Coder-0.5B plus existing full-weight supervised adaptation

sweep.quantization_origin: publisher Q8; not an F16-to-Q4 ablation

decoding: greedy, own tokenizer, actual EOG required; no text trimming or repair
condition: normal desktop applications remain; no competing build/conversion/download/benchmark on inference host
latency: completed returned canonical action; changed-state and identical-repeat separate; user debounce/UI stages measured only in editor smoke
selection_rule: Prefer useful prefix-preserving replacement coverage on declared development examples, finite valid EOS actions, bounded target RAM; choose lower changed-state latency among correct comparable runtime settings; preserve q25 default unless Sweep demonstrates a better useful same-task tradeoff. Small correlated development sample does not establish production accuracy.
scope_notes: 24 deterministic source-state transitions, source-size bucket is not tokenizer length
all prompts constructed by resident context worker; actual prompt lengths recorded
Sweep uses a declared cropped whole-window task and only strict unchanged surrounding bytes map to a one-line action
Sweep insertion/deletion mappings unsupported; these remain failed capability cases, never repaired
24 preselected development cases with6of each action; related synthetic families are codec checks, not human-quality evidence
sealed data unchanged and not accessed
model files outsideGit; only code/reports pushed
revision_explanation: Preserve v1 baseline. Adds one explicitly versioned same-information cursor-last prompt experiment, exact producer fingerprint checks, and remaining timeout guards. Original fixture and scoring unchanged; existing baseline settings continue using unchanged trained prompt layout.
context_experiment_selection: Adopt only if useful changed-state latency improves and the predeclared24 development action pairs show no lost correct edit-required actions, no reduced canonical/EOS validity, and no added no-edit false changes. Otherwise retain control. No production accuracy claim from24 correlated cases.
